entities.summary: Tural Aghalarzade is an Azerbaijani karateka. He won the gold medal in the men's 67 kg event at the 2023 European Games held in Poland. He won one of the bronze medals in the men's 67 kg event at the 2021 Islamic Solidarity Games held in Konya, Turkey.
